caption: The video captures an underwater scene where a masked figure in a shiny gray suit moves along a sloping, sandy seabed beneath slanting sun rays. A large boulder rests to the right, and a trail of bubbles rises above the head. The figure is already in motion on the first frame, oriented toward the camera in an upright, stride-like pose with elbows bent at the sides. As the sequence unfolds, the body rotates from this front view into a right-facing side profile. The arms swing outward and spread wide, then draw inward, then forward and downward as the posture lowers into a crouch. The legs shift from a vertical stride to bent knees, then trail behind as the torso tilts toward horizontal. The figure moves toward the right of the frame, growing closer. The rays, bubbles, and seabed texture remain consistent.
relations: Upright front-facing stride pose rotates into a right-facing side profile as the figure moves closer.
Bent elbows swing outward, then inward and downward as the torso tilts toward horizontal.
Vertical stride legs bend into a crouch and trail behind during the forward rightward motion.
Sun rays, rising bubbles, and sandy seabed texture remain consistent throughout the sequence.
